rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act—Notice of Tenant's Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: When a landlord ends a tenancy agreement by Notice to Quit or non-renewal of lease, the landlord must provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the eviction notice.
rules.quotedSpan: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ANY LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental buildings in Boston.
warnings: The statute's effective date is not stated in this page; no date has been independently verified.
Violation does not halt eviction; enforcement is by City warning or $300/day fine (2nd+ offenses).
Landlord must also submit Notice to City via online portal or face fines up to $300/day.
This page describes a 2024 Boston ordinance requiring notice documents, not substantive eviction standards; it does not establish just-cause requirements but only a disclosure obligation.
The actual ordinance text (Sec. 10-11.7) was not provided; this summary is based on the city's informational page.
